title: Chevalam - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Chevalam in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Chevalam is a physical-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Agility (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Chevalam
sections.content:
Location: Crimson Forest - defeat the area's final boss.

Obtained from Crimson Forest - defeat the area's final boss.

sections.title: Is the Chevalam Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (B), Luck (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
